jcr:title: Stryker Orthopaedics Debuts Final Episode of its Three-Part Series "Road Trip to a Healthier Lifestyle" featuring Jerome Bettis and Fred Funk

text.text:
MAHWAH, N.J., Sept. 20, 2017 /PRNewswire/ -- Stryker Orthopaedics released the third and final episode of its three-part content series, "Road Trip to a Healthier Lifestyle." The series features brand ambassadors, NFL Hall of Famer, Jerome Bettis, and PGA TOUR Champions golfer and GetAroundKnee® recipient, Fred Funk on a cross country fitness journey across the nation.

The duo visited the Big Apple to wrap-up their #StrykerActive mission of encouraging fans to participate in everyday health-related initiatives. For the final episode, fans will enjoy watching Bettis and Funk work out at a state-of-art indoor golf training facility, followed by a fun round of bowling. To conclude the series, the duo reflects on their entire road trip on the iconic New York City Highline.

To watch the entire series visit www.StrykerChallenge.com
